data.description:
## Context
ADR 0100 makes the immutable route registry and parser factories the authority for command identity, grammar, and committed help. Twenty-one visible intercept routes support `rebar <command> --help` but remain absent from overview help and fail under `rebar help <command>`.

## Plan
- Derive visible overview membership from the existing route registry.
- Serve `rebar help <command>` from the route-owned committed artifact for every visible canonical route.
- Preserve hidden aliases, retired spellings, nested command help, no-extra startup, and pre-operation no-mount behavior.
- Regenerate package help and the CLI reference through existing generators.
- Add focused behavioral and generator coverage.
- Do not add another router, parser, or help source.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every visible canonical route appears exactly once in overview help.
- [ ] `rebar help review-plan` and representative intercept routes succeed without executing work or mounting a store.
- [ ] `rebar help <command>` and `rebar <command> --help` use the same committed command artifact where the route owns top-level help.
- [ ] Hidden aliases and retired spellings remain absent from overview discovery.
- [ ] Nested command help retains its current ownership.
- [ ] Help and CLI reference drift checks pass.
- [ ] No competing routing or parser mechanism is introduced.
data.title: F12 complete ADR 0100 CLI command discovery
